### 1. Scene
A fresh mixed-fruit plate, without visible dressing or syrup.

### 2. Vessel
A square plate, approximately 24 cm across. Allowing for its rounded corners, an equivalent circular diameter of **26 cm** gives an estimated area of:
**3.14 × 13² = 531 cm²**.

### 3. Items
Watermelon, strawberries, blueberries, blackberry, raspberries, pineapple, cantaloupe, and a few orange/mandarin pieces. The orange-colored pieces are somewhat uncertain.

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight, and energy
Using **0.6 g/ml** bulk density for all the cut fruit and berries:

| Item | Plate area | Area, cm² | Height, cm | Gross volume, ml | Weight, g | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Watermelon | 25% | 133 | 2.7 | 359 | 215 | 30 | 65 |
| Strawberries | 12% | 64 | 1.7 | 109 | 65 | 32 | 21 |
| Blueberries | 4% | 21 | 1.2 | 25 | 15 | 57 | 9 |
| Blackberry | 2% | 11 | 1.7 | 19 | 11 | 43 | 5 |
| Raspberries | 2% | 11 | 1.5 | 17 | 10 | 52 | 5 |
| Pineapple | 7% | 37 | 2.2 | 81 | 49 | 50 | 25 |
| Cantaloupe | 8% | 42 | 2.2 | 92 | 55 | 34 | 19 |
| Orange/mandarin pieces | 4% | 21 | 1.7 | 36 | 22 | 47 | 10 |
| **Total** | **64%** | **340** | | **838** | **442** | | **159** |

### 8. Sanity check
Approximately two-thirds of the plate is covered, with some fruit stacked. **About 440 g and 160 kcal** is plausible for the visible amount of fresh fruit.
